ja: 昼まで、彼は折り返さなかった。
en: Not until noon did he call back.
alternatives: He didn't call back until noon.
It wasn't until noon that he called back.
point: Not until を前に出すと did + 主語 + 原形

ja: 恐縮ですが、声が少し途切れています。
en: I'm afraid you're breaking up a bit.
alternatives: I'm afraid the line's breaking up a little.
Sorry, but you're breaking up a bit.
point: I'm afraid と a bit で角を丸める。途切れる = break up

ja: 君が早くかけてれば、彼は出たよ。
en: If you'd called earlier, he'd have answered.
alternatives: If you had called sooner, he'd have answered.
If you'd called sooner, he'd have picked up.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞, would have + 過去分詞

ja: さっきまで、よく聞こえてたよ。
en: You were coming through fine earlier.
alternatives: I could hear you fine earlier.
Your audio was fine a minute ago.
point: さっきまでは過去形、今との対比

ja: 彼はすぐ折り返すと言ってた。
en: He said he'd call right back.
alternatives: He told me he'd call you back soon.
He said he would call you back shortly.
point: said のあとは will が would になる

ja: 彼、私の電話を無視したに違いない。
en: He must have ignored my call.
alternatives: He must have screened my call.
I'm sure he ignored my call.
point: must have + 過去分詞で過去の強い推量

ja: あとで折り返します。
en: I'll call you back later.
alternatives: I'll get back to you later.
I'm going to call you back.
point: 折り返しは call back。目的語は間に入れる

ja: 私は彼にかけ直してほしい。
en: I want him to call back.
alternatives: I'd like him to call back.
I'd like a callback from him.
point: want him to call back は彼に電話をかけ直してほしいという希望。

ja: 私は君を内線につなげられる。
en: I can connect you to an extension.
alternatives: I can transfer you to an extension.
I can put you through internally.
point: extension は社内の内線番号や回線。

ja: 受付にお客様がいます。
en: There's a visitor at reception.
alternatives: There is a guest at reception.
A visitor is at reception.
point: いる は There's + 単数。a を忘れない

ja: 雑音はあるが、だいたい聞き取れた。
en: Despite the static, I caught most of it.
alternatives: Even with the static, I caught most of it.
Although there was static, I caught most of it.
point: Despite の後ろは名詞。節なら Although

ja: 30分も保留のままです。
en: I've been holding for 30 minutes.
alternatives: I've been on hold for 30 minutes.
I've been on hold 30 minutes now.
point: 続いている動作は have been -ing

ja: 君が電話してたら私は今手探りじゃない。
en: Had you called, I wouldn't be flying blind.
alternatives: If you'd called, I wouldn't be in the dark.
I'd have some clue now if you'd called.
point: flying blind は必要な情報なしで手探りすること。

ja: 君は声を大きくすべき。
en: You should speak louder.
alternatives: You ought to speak louder.
You should raise your voice.
point: louder は今より大きな声で。

ja: 詳しい者を呼びますね。
en: I'll get someone who knows more.
alternatives: Let me get someone who knows more.
I'll find someone who knows more.
point: someone の後ろに who 節をつける

ja: 私は給与係とずっと電話が行き違う。
en: I've been playing phone tag with payroll.
alternatives: Payroll and I keep playing phone tag.
Payroll and I can't connect by phone.
point: play phone tag は互いの折り返し電話が行き違うこと。

ja: 声が途切れて聞き取りにくいです。
en: Breaking up, you're hard to follow.
alternatives: You keep breaking up, so you're hard to follow.
Your voice is cutting out, so I can't follow.
You're breaking up, so I can't follow you.
point: 音声が途切れるは break up。分詞構文で理由を添える

ja: 音声にラグがあります。
en: There's a lag.
alternatives: There's a delay.
There's audio lag.
The audio is lagging.
point: ラグは a lag。There's + 単数名詞

ja: 今、担当者につながりました。
en: I've just reached the right person.
alternatives: I've just gotten through to the right person.
I've just been connected to the right person.
point: 今つながったところは現在完了 + just

ja: 何度も途切れるのは、音声のほうです。
en: It's the audio that keeps cutting out.
alternatives: It's the audio that keeps dropping out.
The audio is what keeps cutting out.
point: It's + 強調語 + that で「途切れるのは音声」を強調

ja: 私は接続を確かめなきゃ。
en: I need to check the connection.
alternatives: I have to verify the connection.
I must check the connection.
point: check the connection は通話の接続状態を確かめる。

ja: 恐縮ですが私にはお話が理解不能でした。
en: I'm afraid what you said went over my head.
alternatives: I'm afraid I couldn't understand what you said.
Sorry, what you said was beyond me.
point: go over my head は難しくて理解できないこと。

ja: さっきから声が途切れてるよ。
en: You've been cutting out on me.
alternatives: You keep breaking up.
Your audio keeps cutting out.
point: 声や音が途切れるは cut out / break up

ja: 電話した時、彼はもう帰っていた。
en: He'd already left when I called.
alternatives: He had already gone home when I called.
When I called, he'd already left.
point: 電話した時より前の出来事は過去完了

ja: もっとゆっくりお願い！
en: Could you speak more slowly?
alternatives: Can you slow down a little?
Please speak a bit slower.
point: slowly の比較級は more slowly

ja: 伝言、承ります。
en: I'll take a message.
alternatives: Let me take a message.
I can take a message.
point: 「伝言を預かる」は take a message

ja: 雑音が入ってます。
en: There's some static.
alternatives: There's some noise.
I'm hearing static.
point: ある・入っている は There's。static は雑音

ja: 今おつなぎしています。
en: I'm connecting you now.
alternatives: I'm putting you through.
I'm transferring your call.
point: 電話をつなぐは connect / put through

ja: もう一回言ってもらえる？
en: Could you say that again?
alternatives: Could you repeat that?
Can you say that again?
point: 聞き返しの依頼は Could you〜？

ja: 経理の者におつなぎします。
en: I'll connect you to someone in accounting.
alternatives: I'll put you through to someone in accounting.
Let me transfer you to someone in accounting.
point: someone の後ろに in accounting を足して絞る

ja: お名前は何ですか？
en: What's your name?
alternatives: Could I get your name?
May I have your name?
point: 電話で丁寧に聞くなら May I have〜？も使える

ja: 君の声が小さい。
en: Your voice is quiet.
alternatives: Your voice is soft.
You sound quiet.
point: voice の状態を is で表す。

ja: 通話は録音されています。
en: This call is being recorded.
alternatives: This call is recorded.
We're recording this call.
point: 「今〜されている」は be being＋過去分詞

ja: 戻ったら彼が電話します。
en: He'll call when he's back.
alternatives: He'll call you when he returns.
When he gets back, he'll call you.
point: when 節は未来のことでも現在形

ja: 私が電話を切った。
en: I ended the call.
alternatives: I hung up.
I finished the call.
point: ended で通話を終えた過去を表す。

ja: 回線が悪いと思います。
en: I think the line's bad.
alternatives: I think the connection is bad.
I think we have a bad connection.
point: I think のあとの that 節は that を省ける

ja: 回線がもっと良ければいいのに。
en: I wish the connection were better.
alternatives: I wish we had a better connection.
If only the connection were better.
point: 今の願望は wish + 過去形、be は were

ja: 彼から折り返し電話させます。
en: I'll have him call you back.
alternatives: I'll get him to call you back.
I'll make sure he calls you back.
point: have + 人 + 動詞の原形

ja: かけてきたのは田中でなく鈴木。
en: It was Suzuki, not Tanaka, who called.
alternatives: It was Suzuki who called, not Tanaka.
Suzuki called, not Tanaka.
point: 人が強調されるときは It was + 人 + who

ja: 大きな声なら、聞き取れるのに。
en: If you spoke louder, I could hear you.
alternatives: If you spoke up, I could hear you.
I could hear you if you spoke louder.
point: 現在の仮定は if + 過去形, could + 原形

ja: ゆっくり話して。
en: Please speak slowly.
alternatives: Speak slowly, please.
Please slow down.
point: 命令文は動詞から始め、please で和らげる

ja: お電話ですが、どなたですか？
en: May I ask who's calling?
alternatives: Could you tell me who's calling?
Can I ask who this is?
point: 電話では Who are you? でなく who's calling
